invalidAttempts.cause: a race in the frozen bring-up script, found by repeating 16.4.0 by hand with the logs kept: it asks PostgreSQL to create the databases while the server is restarting after its own first initialisation, and psql finds no socket. The candidate container had not been started. The same script had come up about forty times before; the machine was busier this time.
invalidAttempts.handling: these two entries are not screening results. The screen now tries the bring-up up to three times and keeps every failure with its reason; both releases are screened again.
